authorization: The repository owner requested native Guitar Pro validation and completion of the GitHub tickets. The six-note score derives from the repository-owned mix-table fixture.

provenance.method: Controlled XML seeds followed by native Tuning edits/Keep the Fingering, Save As, reopening and native MIDI export.
provenance.limit: String selection in the seeds was edited as XML. It was not selected through the inaccessible native string-selection menu. Named Tuning dialog labels and native MIDI establish the mapping independently.
provenance.format_scope: Native authoring used Guitar Pro 8.1.5 only. GP7/GP8 use the same ZIP/GPIF property family. No Guitar Pro 7 application session is claimed.
provenance.string_convention: Tuning dialog string 1 is high E MIDI64; string 4 is D MIDI50. Notes appear in public high-to-low string order. The track tooltip labels strings in reverse order; it is not the naming authority.
provenance.legacy_attempt: conformance/capabilities/evidence/partial-capo-acquisition.json remains the unchanged failed earlier attempt.

Edited whole and partial absolute capo to 5. Saved, reopened Tuning and exported MIDI. Native wire retains selection flags 001001 with zero offset; UI says No strings capoed.
Opened the all-string XML seed with note frets 0,1,2,3,4,5. Used Keep the Fingering, saved and exported MIDI.

decisions.flag_order: The rightmost wire character selects public string 1. 000001 affects only MIDI64, 001000 affects only MIDI50, and 001001 affects both.
decisions.offset_units: PartialCapoFret is relative to CapoFret. Native absolute whole2/partial5 produces wire whole2/offset3.
decisions.pitch_rule: Only selected open-string notes receive the partial offset. Selected fretted notes retain tuning + whole capo + note fret.
decisions.below_whole: Native typing partial2 while whole5 leaves partial5 after Tab. The finite boundary is offset0. Negative XML offset-3 displays24 and is invalid experimental data, not a valid below-whole fixture.
decisions.reference_limit: Pinned AlphaTab ignores partial properties, so its numeric note values omit the partial shift. Preserve native-correct source data despite that reference difference.
decisions.implementation_followup: The proven Staff.PartialCapo API, parser, pitch calculation and exporter are under implementation and final review in the same release work.
